descriptions.zh:
1. 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。

descriptions.en:
1. You must purchase DataWorks Basic Edition or a higher edition to use this feature. 2. You must have at least one of the following roles in the DataWorks project space:
Tenant Owner, Space Administrator, Deployment, Developer, Project Owner, or O\&M.
